Main exact support is15tones,4chirps,2transients,3modulation events, and0broadband positives. F recovers8/1/1/2 respectively; G4 recovers14/1/0/2. Broadband zeroF1 is not a positive-class performance estimate; retain itsFP counts and null recall. All six localizer seeds recover the two transient references but no chirp references; this tiny support does not establish broad transient robustness. P1 has no recovered modulation events; P2 seeds each recover one with saved7–9FP. No per-class confidence intervals are saved, and no mean across seeds was calculated here.

Main explicit overlaps_time relation results areF TP1/FP5/FN19 F1=.076923 andG4 TP6/FP6/FN14 F1=.375. These are emitted edges mapped through the unchanged matched nodes; dangling/ambiguous/unmatched/malformed/duplicate edges can beFP. They differ from the common evaluator geometric temporal-overlap metric and cannot be called natural-language explanation correctness. The TF supplement instead derives edges from geometry with2Hz total narrowband support, same domains and compatible modulation carriers, using piecewise-linear segment intersection. It does not assess emitted reasoning.

value.stage: After completed supervised baselines and failed AI-reference qualification; before main generative inference.
value.purpose: Secondary completion of outlined explicit temporal-relation and time-frequency-overlap assessment; no inference, rematching, primary score replacement, or real-reference qualification.
value.node_matching: Read unchanged event_metrics.matches and ignored_predictions from each run/evaluation/per_episode.jsonl; indices follow its scoped valid predictions and required exact gold events. No rematching or tolerance changes.
value.reference_scope: Only exact synthetic strata, including synthetic duration/display interventions. Unenumerated modulation and known optional beat harmonics receive neither TP credit nor FP/FN penalties. Real, mixtures of real sources and real interventions remain unavailable.

reported_temporal.endpoint_identity: Use actual report component IDs, not canonical detector IDs or inferred edges. Nonunique IDs are ambiguous.
reported_temporal.gold_edges: All unordered pairs of required gold nodes with overlap/min(duration)>0.1, including cross-frequency-domain pairs; this matches the original temporal criterion.
reported_temporal.prediction_edges: Only explicitly emitted overlaps_time relations. A relation with more than two component_ids denotes all unordered pairs; repeated emissions give at most one TP, with additional copies FP.
reported_temporal.invalid_edges: Dangling, ambiguous, invalid-geometry or unmatched endpoints and self-relations are FP. A malformed overlaps_time object contributes one FP. Missing/other/untyped relations do not invent a temporal claim; missing gold edges remain FN.
reported_temporal.unscored_edges: A pair with a known optional or out-of-scope endpoint is ignored unless another endpoint is dangling/ambiguous/invalid, which remains a malformed FP.
reported_temporal.interpretation: Correctness of explicit reported temporal edges under the declared geometric reference. Does not score natural-language explanations, causal associations or physical source identity.

geometry.narrowband_support: Nominal [center(t)-1Hz,center(t)+1Hz] tolerance tube; center is piecewise linear over all recorded frequency_track knots with constant endpoint extension. Without a track use mean(frequency_hz). Width is not expanded by detector or model uncertainty and nominal support is not clipped at DC.
geometry.regional_support: Static declared frequency_hz band with positive width. Zero-width regional boxes cannot induce TF overlap.
geometry.time_rule: Positive temporal intersection and a positive-duration interval with strictly positive frequency-support intersection. Boundary-only time/frequency contact is not overlap.
geometry.carrier_rule: Both modulation nodes require positive carrier bands; carrier intersection/min(carrier widths)>=0.5. Acoustic nodes do not require carriers.
geometry.algorithm: Float64 CUDA union of common-time boundaries and all interior track knots, then exact strict linear-inequality intersection on every segment. No fixed time grid or sampling approximation.
geometry.scoring: Infer unordered TF edges from prediction and required gold geometry, map predicted endpoints using the saved common node matches; unmatched endpoints yield FP, unmapped gold edges FN. Optional nodes are removed. Invalid geometry cannot induce a TF edge and is separately counted, while its original node FP remains unchanged.
geometry.interpretation: Geometry-induced TF overlap only; not an explicit relation or reasoning metric.

value.aggregation: Separate stratum/domain/method micro TP,FP,FN,precision,recall,F1. Empty-empty graph F1=0, undefined precision/recall=null; count zero-gold-edge episodes explicitly. Do not pool real/synthetic or original/intervention strata.
value.bootstrap: Use existing common group_metric_intervals with frozen independent recording/provenance groups and seed603. Descriptive sampling uncertainty only, no new confirmatory hypothesis or model-seed independence claim.
value.provenance: Require matching manifest/run/common-evaluator/metrics hashes and episode hashes. Record exact-truth SHA and saved match list per result; original common rows lack per-truth SHA, so preserve sealed truth and its generation provenance without claiming a nonexistent common truth-hash check.
value.numerical_execution: CUDA only. CPU limited to JSON, identifiers, metadata, grouping, source hashing and artifact I/O.
value.validation: 12 analytic CUDA toy tests cover crossings, piecewise knots, disjoint/boundary cases, broadband support, carrier compatibility, dangling/unmatched/duplicate/self/malformed relations, optional scope, actual IDs and empty graphs. No experiment outcomes used.

findings.finding: Main TF relation gold support is only one edge;11of12scenes have no goldTFedge. All five main methods haveTP0/FN1, with differingFP. Robustness and sensitivity have no goldTFedges at all: their savedTF recall isnull, and F1=0 must not be described as failed positive-edge recovery. They still provide scoped extra-edge diagnostics. Optional and excluded modulation nodes are not scored. Intervals are marginal group sampling, not paired comparisons; degenerate defined-draw precision intervals are not certainty (F main explicit precision has only.629500031 defined resample fraction). No localizer relation assessment was declared or generated.
